items.whatItShows: Wide view from the upper stands of a dark, packed arena during Nvidia's CES 2025 keynote. Thousands of seated spectators, a single glowing LED wall showing a mosaic of server-rack images, a tiny figure on stage, lighting trusses overhead.
items.subjectRegion: LED wall is the only bright mass: a wide rectangle slightly left of centre, spanning about 32-61% of the width and 39-55% of the height. Crowd fills the lower 55% and the whole right side, rising in a diagonal bank to the upper right.
items.negativeSpace: Upper-left quarter is near-pure black (x 0-30%, y 0-45%) and is the best place for text. The ceiling band across the top 35% is dark with fine truss lines and small spotlights. Lower-left corner is also very dark (foreground stands and railings).
items.depthStructure: Strong, continuous depth. Foreground: stair railings and the backs of spectators at bottom centre and bottom left. Middle: the floor seating and a diagonal aisle leading to the stage. Background: LED wall, far stands at right, roof trusses. Expect very good depth separation with a smooth recession from bottom-left to the screen.
items.tonalNotes: 63% of pixels are near black, mean luminance 35/255. Highlights only in the LED wall and a few ceiling spots. The crowd sits in low mid-greys with fine speckle texture; lift the mid-tones slightly if the crowd needs to read.
items.cropAdvice: Works full-bleed at 16:9 as is. Can be cropped to 21:9 by trimming the bottom railings and top of the ceiling. Keep the screen off-centre left.
